I was staying with friends in Pigneto, sometimes called “the Brooklyn of Rome,” a neighborhood full of night life, young people, and artists. Rather than ending a war (completely within his power) or announcing replacements for some of his truly despised Cabinet members (also in his power), President Donald Trump has done something bold and unexpected. He has decided that, on every day of the homestretch for this year’s midterms, and despite the already big lead Democrats have in the polls, he will do something to undercut any remaining Republican candidate’s chances for victory, to destroy the GOP majorities in the House and Senate and the MAGA brand.
